name: PT Aspirasi Hidup Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Aspirasi Hidup Indonesia Tbk engages in the retail of home improvement products in Indonesia. The company operates through Home Improvement Products, Lifestyle Products, and Toys Products segments. It offers bathroom and laundry, renovation and household equipment, electronics, and lamp and bulbs; kitchen, hobby and lifestyle, home accents, Olahraga dan outdoor, automotive, and cleaning tools; and toys. The company also engages in trading; real estate; transportation and warehousing; accommodation and food and beverage services; and information and communication business.
